summary: Short flat kerb on a parked-up residential street; house 13 m away.

best_section.where: West kerb of York Street, level with the kindergarten, beside a parked car

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 13 m on the same side, kindergarten 11 m; apartments 22 m or more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parking lane; only 12 m of kerb, so room for one van at most.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, modest local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but No Stopping, No Parking and 1/4P signs sit right at this stretch.

flags: Mixed No Stopping and short-stay signs close by
Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Street trees on the east side shade the morning; west kerb open.
